items.title: 12.1.3 Meaning of the Phrase "x approaches a" (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ab teesra aur sab se ahem jumla: "x approaches a". Pichle do sabaqon mein \(n\) infinity ki taraf ja raha tha. Ab hum ek aam variable \(x\) ki baat kar rahe hain jo kisi khaas number \(a\) ke qareeb ja raha hai. Limit ki definition isi jumle par khari hai, is liye ise dil se samjhiye.

Kitab kehti hai: is ko symbol mein "\(x \to a\)" likhte hain, jis ka matlab hai ke \(x\), number \(a\) ke kaafi qareeb hai lekin \(a\) se mukhtalif hai, aur yeh qurbat \(a\) ke baayein (left) aur daayein (right) dono taraf se hai. Yani \(x - a\) jitna chahein chhota hota jata hai lekin \(x - a \ne 0\).

blocks.title: Point to remember
blocks.text:
Nishan \(x \to 0\), \(x = 0\) se bilkul mukhtalif hai.
\(x \to 0\) ka matlab hai \(x\) zero ke bohat qareeb hai lekin asal mein zero nahin.
\(x = 0\) ka matlab hai \(x\) waqai zero hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
"Chhota aur chhota" yahan \(x - a\) ke size ki baat hai, yani number line par \(x\) aur \(a\) ka faasla \(|x - a|\). Baayein se aayein to \(x - a\) negative hota hai (jaise \(1.99 - 2 = -0.01\)), daayein se positive (jaise \(2.01 - 2 = 0.01\)). Lekin dono surat mein us ka size zero ki taraf sukarta hai.
Kyun faasla (modulus) lete hain: \(-0.01\) number ke hisaab se \(0.001\) se chhota hai, lekin \(2\) se door hai. Qurbat napne ke liye sign nahin, size chahiye.
To \(x \to a\) ka matlab: \(0 < |x - a|\) aur \(|x - a|\) ko jitna chahein chhota kiya ja sakta hai. "\(0 <\)" wala hissa hi sharat \(x \ne a\) hai.

blocks.caption: Hamari table (kitab mein nahin): x dono taraf se a = 2 ke qareeb aa raha hai; faasla ghatta hai magar kabhi 0 nahin hota.

blocks.text: Table mein dekhiye: upar ke teen \(x\) baayein se aa rahe hain, neeche ke teen daayein se. Har qadam par faasla das guna kam ho raha hai: \(0.1\), \(0.01\), \(0.001\). Lekin \(x = 2\) kahin nahin aaya. Yahi \(x \to 2\) hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(x\) ko \(a\) se mukhtalif kyun rakhte hain? Kyun ke limit yeh batati hai ke function \(a\) ke qareeb kya kar raha hai, \(a\) par kya kar raha hai yeh nahin. Bohat se ahem functions ki \(a\) par koi value hoti hi nahin.
Misal: \(f(x) =  rac{x^{2} - 4}{x - 2}\) ki \(x = 2\) par koi value nahin, kyun ke \( rac{0}{0}\) aata hai, aur \( rac{0}{0}\) ka koi matlab nahin. Lekin har \(x 
e 2\) ke liye \(x^{2} - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2)\), to \(f(x) = x + 2\). Is liye jab \(x 	o 2\), values \(4\) ke qareeb jaati hain.
Kyun cancel karna jaayez hai: \(x 	o 2\) mein \(x 
e 2\), to \(x - 2 
e 0\), aur ghair-zero cheez ko cancel kar sakte hain. Jumla "\(x 	o 2\)" humein yeh sab kehne deta hai bina kabhi \(x = 2\) rakhe.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(x \to 5\) ke liye baayein aur daayein se teen teen values likhiye jin ka faasla \(5\) se \(0.1\), \(0.01\), \(0.001\) ho.
Jawab: baayein se \(4.9, 4.99, 4.999\); daayein se \(5.1, 5.01, 5.001\). Aur kya \(5\) khud is list mein aata hai? Nahin.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: Socho aap darwaze ki ghanti bajane ke liye ungli button ke qareeb le ja rahe hain: 1 cm, phir 1 mm, phir aadha mm... Ungli button ke jitna chahein qareeb hai, lekin abhi daba nahin raha. "Qareeb jaana" aur "pohanch jaana" do alag cheezein hain. \(x \to a\) qareeb jaana hai; \(x = a\) pohanch jaana.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: \(x \to a\) ka matlab poocha jaye to teen baatein likhiye: (1) \(x\), \(a\) ke jitna chahein qareeb aata hai, (2) \(a\) ke baayein aur daayein dono taraf se, (3) \(x \ne a\), yani \(x - a \ne 0\). Teeno likhenge to poore number milenge.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(x \to a\): \(x\), \(a\) ke jitna chahein qareeb aata hai, dono taraf se.
2. \(x\) kabhi \(a\) ke barabar nahin hota: \(x - a \ne 0\).
3. \(x \to 0\) (zero ke bohat qareeb, zero nahin) aur \(x = 0\) (bilkul zero) do alag baatein hain.
4. Qurbat faasle \(|x - a|\) se naapi jaati hai, sign se nahin.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sirf ek taraf se qareeb jaana. \(x \to 2\) mein \(1.99\) jaisi values bhi aati hain aur \(2.01\) jaisi bhi. Sirf ek taraf ho to woh one-sided limit hai, jo 12.3.1 mein aayegi.
2. \(x \to a\) likh kar phir aise expression mein \(x = a\) rakh dena jo \(\frac{0}{0}\) ban jaye. \(a\) ke qareeb hum simplify kar sakte hain (\(x - a\) cancel, kyun ke \(x - a \ne 0\)); \(a\) par zero se divide nahin kar sakte.
3. Yeh samajhna ke \(x \to a\) mein \(x\) dheere dheere \(a\) ban jata hai. Kabhi nahin banta; sirf qareeb se qareeb tar hota hai.
